recommendation: Keep this commit as a narrow current-build cleanup for FHIR-17770. No further Contract source change is needed unless a work group chooses to replace broad Reference(Resource) uses with narrower target profiles; the current Person page already supplies the cross-resource prohibition that prevents using Person as a clinical or administrative relationship target.
issue_request: FHIR-17770 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked FM to remove Person from Contract reference targets because Person is only for linking shared demographics across Patient, Practitioner, and RelatedPerson records and must not be used as a Contract author, publisher, party, subject, or other actor/relationship target.
initial_application: Commit d7062ffc63083b79035d7c83ca51451d5c3939b0 (GF #17770) applied the issue to the old Contract spreadsheet by removing Person from explicit Contract reference lists such as author, publisher, party, action subject/requester, performer, and signer. The current XML StructureDefinition already had no explicit targetProfile for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Person, but the asset-context definition still described a referenced owner as an owning Person or Organization.
additional_context: Contract remains active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current Person narrative says Person instances are never directly referenced as actors and SHALL NOT be referenced by other clinical or administrative resources. A 2018 committers Zulip thread also called out several Contract Person-reference targets as part of the broader late-R4 Person cleanup. Later source history added RelatedPerson to Contract.author, reinforcing that role-specific resources may be used where an individual actor is needed while Person itself is not the actor resource.
reconciliation: Changed Contract.term.asset.context.reference wording to describe the asset creator, custodian, or owner without naming Person, and updated the matching checked-in Contract SVG tooltip so the diagram artifact no longer preserves the stale cue.
source_changes: source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml: reworded Contract.term.asset.context.reference to remove the capitalized Person reference and use role-neutral owner wording.
source/contract/contract.svg: updated the matching tooltip for Contract.term.asset.context.reference so the checked-in diagram no longer repeats the stale Person wording.

related_jiras.note: Later source history added RelatedPerson to Contract.author, supporting the distinction between role-specific person resources and the Person linkage resource; it was not independently decided in this run.
